Markets.title: Indian bonds rise on short covering before Fed decision
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds gained value as crude oil prices retreated and traders covered short positions ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy decision. Bond yields also eased following the stabilization of global debt markets and Saudi Arabia's offer of additional oil cargoes.

Markets.title: ASF Group rents 4 lakh sq ft office space to Genpact in Gurugram
Markets.summary: ASF Group has leased four lakh square feet of office space to Genpact at ASF Insignia in Gurugram. This transaction represents an entire commercial tower and stands as one of the largest office space deals in the Delhi-NCR region.

Markets.title: Maruti Suzuki among 8 large-cap stocks to hit 52-week lows and fall up to 12% in a month
Markets.summary: Despite the Sensex gaining 332 points on Wednesday, eight BSE 100 large-cap stocks hit fresh 52-week lows. The affected companies include Maruti Suzuki, Shree Cement, IRFC, Britannia, Ambuja Cements, Godrej Consumer, Bank of Baroda, and Muthoot Finance.

Markets.title: Market wrap: SBI, HDFC Life, TCS, Infosys top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities rose over 0.4 percent on September 16, driven by value buying in banking and heavyweight stocks. Investors are now awaiting the Federal Reserve's upcoming rate decision and guidance.

Markets.title: Quote of the day by Edward Thorp: "I think that we only get estimates of the distributions and that we can only be somewhat sure of the estimates. That makes the problems in the financial world much more difficult, I think, because you have these uncertainties in the distributions."
Markets.summary: Edward Thorp notes that financial markets rely on uncertain probability estimates rather than fixed certainties. Because forecasts struggle with unexpected events, investors must prioritize risk management, diversification, and resilience over overconfidence.

Markets.title: ‘Biggest crash in history has begun’: Rich Dad Poor Dad author Robert Kiyosaki sounds the alarm
Markets.summary: *Rich Dad Poor Dad* author Robert Kiyosaki warned that a historic global stock and bond market crash has begun, starting in Europe and Japan. He cited factors including artificial intelligence speculation, rising debt, war, and demographic pressures as drivers of the downturn.

Geo-Political.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Following a breakdown in relations with the United States under President Donald Trump, Canada is seeking closer ties with the European Union. In response, the EU chief has backed a proposal for Canada to become an associate member of the bloc.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged that public fear of artificial intelligence is justified due to potential threats to humanity. However, he and other tech leaders argued that sufficient incentives exist to prevent reckless advancements by AI firms.

Geo-Political.title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
Geo-Political.summary: All supporting acts withdrew from Ed Sheeran's US tour following the removal of Macklemore from the lineup. Sheeran stated he was not responsible for dropping Macklemore after the rapper made pro-Palestinian stage remarks.

Geo-Political.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
Geo-Political.summary: A war-damaged building in Gaza that was struck by Israel last year collapsed, killing 21 people, including eight children. Dozens of people remain missing beneath the rubble where about 10 families had been living.

Geo-Political.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
Geo-Political.summary: A Pentagon inspector confirmed that U.S. military involvement related to Iran has caused munitions shortfalls and resupply bottlenecks. This finding contradicts claims by President Donald Trump that American military supplies are virtually limitless.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
Geo-Political.summary: The Saudi-led coalition stated it shot down a Houthi drone south of the Islamic holy city of Mecca. The Houthis denied targeting the holy city following the accusation.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A content creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in acquiring organic traffic from traditional search engine optimization to artificial intelligence optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workplace productivity. These widely used market solutions drive innovation and efficiency across various industry applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their audiences. Because many different writing tools are available in 2022, finding the right one for specific needs can be challenging.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: New Zealand clears path for trade deal –  What it means?
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand has given parliamentary approval to the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement. The deal covers trade in goods and services, investment, agriculture, mobility, and customs procedures.

Data & Insights.title: New Zealand Parliament passes legislation to implement India FTA
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's Parliament has passed legislation to implement a free trade agreement with India. The landmark deal is expected to take effect in the second half of October, providing immediate duty-free access for over half of New Zealand's exports.

Data & Insights.title: It's a fake! Forged art floods Indian market as masterworks fetch record millions
Data & Insights.summary: Rising prices for Indian art have triggered a flood of forgeries featuring works by renowned artists like MF Husain. In response, experts are urging stronger authentication and careful provenance checks to protect buyers.

Data & Insights.title: Explained | Why US Fed meeting outcome tonight matters more than any FOMC decision in last 3 years
Data & Insights.summary: Tonight's Federal Reserve meeting is crucial for determining the future direction of United States monetary policy following years of economic uncertainty. Observers are closely watching the decision not just for the size of the rate change, but for its broader implications ahead of upcoming elections.

Data & Insights.title: Is inflation becoming too hot to handle? Explained in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Economists project a repo rate hike starting in October due to rising food and fuel costs, an unfavorable base effect, and higher crude oil prices. These inflationary pressures are expected to prompt monetary policy tightening by the central bank.

Data & Insights.title: India needs to raise its game, the private sector must invest more: CEA
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that India must improve its economic performance and called on the private sector to increase investments. He assured that the government will support growth, maintain macroeconomic stability, and pursue deregulation to ease business operations.

India.title: 'Will Work For All': AIDUF Chief After Filing Nomination For Nagaon Bypolls
India.summary: AIUDF chief Badruddin Ajmal filed his nomination for the Nagaon bypolls, promising to work for all residents. He stated that his key priorities include improving education and healthcare, as well as addressing flood and erosion issues.

India.title: 10 Convicts Get Death In 2013 Maoist Attack In Chhattisgarh That Killed 29
India.summary: An Indian court sentenced ten convicts to death for a 2013 Maoist attack in Chhattisgarh. The deadly ambush had killed 29 people, including much of the state's Congress leadership.

India.title: Mystery Woman Enters Death Probe Of Sushant Singh's Ex-Manager Disha Salian
India.summary: A police statement recorded in June 2020 revealed that a mystery woman and two men brought the late manager Disha Salian to the hospital. This information has entered the ongoing death investigation of Salian, who was the former manager of the late actor Sushant Singh.

India.title: Provident Fund Wage Ceiling Hiked To Rs 25,000 From Rs 15,000 Per Month
India.summary: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has raised the monthly wage ceiling from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000. This is the first time the mandatory wage limit has been increased since September 2014.

India.title: "Mockery Of Democracy": Madras High Court On MLAs Resigning To Seek Re-Election
India.summary: The Madras High Court criticized MLAs resigning to seek re-election as a mockery of democracy. This follows the ruling TVK party fielding two former AIADMK legislators who resigned to switch parties in the upcoming bypolls for their previous seats.

India.title: Meghalaya Board SSLC Exam 2027 Timetable Released, Check Exam Dates
India.summary: The Meghalaya Board has released the timetable for the 2027 SSLC exams. The examinations will take place from December 4 to December 16, 2026, in a single daily shift from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.

General.title: Petrol and diesel price rises push UK inflation higher
General.summary: UK inflation increased due to rising petrol and diesel prices. This price growth was driven by summer holidays and Middle East conflicts disrupting global oil supplies.

General.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
General.summary: Canada is seeking closer ties with the European Union following a breakdown in relations with US President Donald Trump. In response, the EU chief has backed a plan for Canada to become an associate member.

General.title: How being music's Mr Nice Guy contributed to biggest crisis of Ed Sheeran's career
General.summary: Ed Sheeran's avoidance of politics and controversy has drawn public criticism. This neutral stance ultimately contributed to the biggest crisis of his music career.

General.title: Village votes to leave UK over asylum housing plan in symbolic referendum
General.summary: Residents of Piddington held a symbolic referendum to vote on leaving the UK. The vote was organized in opposition to a proposal to house up to 1,256 male asylum seekers nearby.

General.title: Author and critic Bonnie Greer dies aged 77
General.summary: Playwright, author, and cultural critic Bonnie Greer has died at the age of 77. Her husband reported that she passed away following a brief illness.

General.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
General.summary: Twenty-one people, including eight children, were killed when a war-damaged building in Gaza collapsed. Dozens of people remain missing beneath the rubble of the structure, which had been struck by an Israeli attack last year and was sheltering about 10 families.
